dimensions.assessment: Affects federal law enforcement personnel, prosecutors, and voluntarily participating state, local, Tribal, and territorial law enforcement agencies.
dimensions.evidence: There is established within the Department of Justice a task force to be known as the Federal Cryptocurrency Theft Task Force

dimensions.assessment: Provides administrative coordination, best practices, training, and reporting structures without altering underlying criminal penalties or regulatory powers.
dimensions.evidence: Nothing in this Act shall be construed to ... create any new criminal offenses

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal appropriations or funding amounts are stated in the source text for the operation of the task force.
Creates a new interagency task force within the DOJ focused on cryptocurrency theft coordination, guidance, and annual reporting to congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: serve as the primary Federal coordinating body for the prevention, investigation, and prosecution of cryptocurrency theft

dimensions.assessment: Establishes ongoing duties and annual reporting requirements for the task force without a specified sunset date.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act, and annually thereafter, the Attorney General shall submit a report

missing_information: Funding authorizations or budget allocations for the task force
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes a Federal Cryptocurrency Theft Task Force within the Department of Justice to coordinate investigations, share information, and provide technical assistance to law enforcement agencies without creating new criminal offenses or regulatory authorities.
